title: Wayfare Pass Desk Tool Card — Ride Credit Corrections on Adjusted Fares
content:
# Ride credit corrections on adjusted fares — Wayfare Pass (rider membership)

## Rule

When a fare that earned Pass ride credit is later reduced by a fare adjustment, the credit correction owed is booked as a credit forfeiture of the trip-refund kind that names the credit earn entry it corrects.

The correction is carried on the trip it concerns: the forfeiture entry names the trip's credit earn entry and carries that entry's trip, calendar month and billing period, and it lowers the member's Pass ride credit balance by the amount booked.

| Before the correction | After the correction |
|---|---|
| A fare that earned Pass ride credit has a fare adjustment booked against it on Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares), and no credit forfeiture of the trip-refund kind names the trip's credit earn entry | A credit forfeiture of the trip-refund kind, dated the day it is booked, names that credit earn entry; the balance is lower by the amount |

## Capability of the tool

`forfeit_pass_ride_credit_4b5902d4` takes back Pass ride credit that a trip earned when the fare of that trip has since been reduced or refunded. One call books one credit forfeiture entry with reason `trip_refunded` on the membership ledger, dated today, pointing at the credit earn entry it reverses and carrying that entry's trip, calendar month and billing period, and lowers the member's Pass ride credit balance by the amount.

## How it is invoked

The support desk books the correction. The agent unlocks the tool with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `pass_membership_id` | The Wayfare Pass membership reference number whose credit is taken back, as returned by the membership lookup. | Identifier string. |
| `original_event_id` | The reference number of the credit earn entry being reversed, as returned by the membership ledger lookup. | Identifier string. |
| `amount` | The credit taken back, in USD. | A positive amount with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent; never empty. |

## Return

On success the tool returns a dictionary with `pass_event_id` (reference number of the forfeiture entry), `pass_membership_id` (the membership concerned), `original_event_id` (the credit earn entry reversed), `amount` (the credit taken back, USD with 2 decimal places) and `member_credit_balance` (the spendable balance once it is taken back, USD with 2 decimal places). The forfeiture then shows on the ledger and the balance is lower by that amount.
